case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your prompt response and value our long-standing partnership. Our family foundry has always taken great pride in the craftsmanship of our people and the enduring relationships we build across our region. 

We are willing to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms. However, to maintain our high quality standards amidst rising wage costs, we can offer a price of €51.60 under these extended terms. 

To summarize our Angebot clearly: we propose a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Specifically, our offer stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. To honor our 12-year relationship, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.90 per unit. This brings us closer to a conclusion while maintaining the quality you expect from our foundry. 

Please consider this our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €50.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 December 2026. This proposal remains valid for 7 days. 

Our family business has always valued the strong connection within our region and the trust built over many years. We hope these terms reflect our commitment to continuing our shared work and success together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
